judgments.reason: January 2024 to March 2025 exceeds one year, and the same source explicitly records weekly handoffs.
judgments.coverage_comment: Both duration of ledger work and handoff frequency are material.

judgments.reason: The source permits shadowing and explicitly says Mara did not present either demo; the answer attributes two presentations to her.
faulty_quotes: Mara presented two customer demos during the April 2025 pilot.
judgments.coverage_comment: Keep the permission to shadow distinct from observed presenting.

judgments.reason: Mara facilitated four post-incident reviews, documented follow-up owners, and the role requires that facilitation.
judgments.coverage_comment: Cover count, candidate facilitation, owner documentation, and role requirement.

judgments.reason: Eighteen triaged alerts establish that triage occurred; three escalations and the six-week pilot context are explicit.
judgments.coverage_comment: Do not lose the distinction between triage and escalation.

judgments.reason: The record proves recorded-interview caption QA and explicitly denies live caption operation. Whether that QA experience is transferable to live operation is an evaluative judgment not settled by the sources.
ambiguous_readings: Transferable means relevant adjacent skill despite no live operation.
Transferable means sufficient operational readiness for this live-caption requirement, which is unestablished.
judgments.coverage_comment: Preserve recorded versus live context and the absence of live-operation experience.

judgments.reason: The three-day permission belonged to a former employer in 2023. This role explicitly permits zero current remote days.
faulty_quotes: This role currently permits Mara to work remotely three days a week.
judgments.coverage_comment: Entity, employment period, and current zero-day rule are all decisive.

judgments.reason: Using OCR to review scans for indexing supports OCR indexing experience, and the source explicitly denies an OCR training certificate.
judgments.coverage_comment: Experience and formal certification are separate claims.

judgments.reason: Three pilot vendor cutovers under engineering signoff and the role requirement for cutover coordination are explicit.
judgments.coverage_comment: Engineering signoff limits Mara’s authority; the answer preserves it.

judgments.reason: An internal security awareness course does not confer CISSP. The source explicitly says Mara has not earned that certification.
faulty_quotes: Mara holds the CISSP certification required by the role.
judgments.coverage_comment: The role requirement is true, but candidate credential possession is false.

judgments.reason: Mara escalated two severity-one alerts during the pilot, the incident lead made final decisions, and the role requires escalation experience.
judgments.coverage_comment: Cover count and severity, escalation recipient, decision boundary, pilot, and role requirement.

judgments.reason: The role does not require production Kubernetes experience, and Mara's recorded use is confined to a personal lab with explicit absence of production operation.
judgments.coverage_comment: Preserve role requirement and candidate experience separately.

judgments.reason: The source says only two of five boxes were processed by September 2025 and the other three remained unprocessed.
faulty_quotes: Mara processed all five boxes in the legal archive by September 2025.
judgments.coverage_comment: The universal quantifier and total count cause the error.

judgments.reason: Two active candidate-fact sources conflict directly on who drafted the same 2025 API migration plan; neither is withdrawn or designated a correction.
ambiguous_readings: The first source is accurate: Mara personally drafted the plan.
The second source is accurate: Mara only reviewed the plan and Jo drafted it.
judgments.coverage_comment: Do not select a source by order or wording alone; preserve Jo’s authorship alternative.

judgments.reason: Mara wrote three bilingual French/English onboarding guides, and the role requires bilingual written guides. The answer does not claim live onboarding.
judgments.coverage_comment: Preserve written-guide modality and the source’s explicit live-session exclusion.

judgments.reason: The 30% improvement belongs to the team. The source expressly withholds individual attribution, while the answer credits Mara with the whole reduction.
faulty_quotes: Mara cut mean triage time by 30% that quarter.
judgments.coverage_comment: Candidate ticket tagging and team outcome must remain distinct.

judgments.reason: Mara wrote rollback plans for three internal pilot deployments, and the role requires rollback-plan documentation. The answer stays within pilot scope.
judgments.coverage_comment: The production-use exclusion is material to avoid upgrading pilot work.

judgments.reason: The active correction says Mara completed the course in May 2025 and did not take the exam; the old certification claim is withdrawn.
judgments.coverage_comment: Keep course completion separate from certification and ignore the withdrawn claim.

judgments.reason: The source explicitly says Mara has not queried a production customer database; sandbox SQL on synthetic data is different.
faulty_quotes: Mara has queried production customer databases with SQL
judgments.coverage_comment: The role requirement is a true premise, but the claimed candidate production experience is false.

judgments.reason: Mara handled onboarding sessions in both French and English, and the role explicitly requires bilingual client onboarding.
judgments.coverage_comment: Two candidate language experiences and the employer requirement are material.

judgments.reason: Mara wrote a pilot runbook and trained three operators; the role asks for both forms of work. The answer stays within pilot scope.
judgments.coverage_comment: Keep the pilot versus production boundary and two requested skills visible.
